{{Quote|Target acquired. Disable the ''Hooded Cloak'' and upload the autopilot program before he jumps out of the system.|[[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] Command, to a CorSec pilot|<ref name="SWG:CtCO" />}}
The '''''Hooded Cloak''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] belonging to a [[Cloak (pirates)|Cloak]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] officer during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The ship was captured by the [[Corellian Security Force]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]<ref name="SWG:CtCO" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> 
{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Hooded Cloak'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CtCO" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The ''Hooded Cloak'' was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:CtCO" />
